en.name: Tiny MSG Viewer
en.tagline: Open .msg & .eml files on your Mac — no Outlook required.
en.promo: Double-click any .msg or .eml on your Mac — read sender, body and attachments instantly, with full HTML and Dark Mode. Export to PDF in one click. No Outlook, no account.
en.cta: View on the Mac App Store
features: Drag & drop, or double-click in Finder to open
Full HTML rendering with inline images, or switch to plain text
Quick Look in Finder — press space to preview without opening the app
Export any email to PDF in one click
Attachments: open, preview, or save to disk
Parses locally on your Mac — your email never leaves your device

qa.q: Does this app need an internet connection?
qa.a: No — opening and reading .msg/.eml files works fully offline. An internet connection is only used if you choose to send feedback from the app menu.

qa.q: Is my email data uploaded anywhere?
qa.a: No. Your .msg/.eml files are parsed entirely on your Mac. The only exception: if you use TinyMSGViewer → Send Feedback, the message you type (and a screenshot if you attach one) is sent to our support channel.
No. Tiny MSG Viewer is a one-time purchase on the Mac App Store — no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

qa.q: Do I need Microsoft Outlook installed?
qa.a: No. Tiny MSG Viewer reads .msg and .eml files on its own — Outlook is not required.

zh-hant.name: Tiny MSG Viewer
zh-hant.tagline: 在 Mac 上開啟 .msg／.eml，免裝 Outlook。
zh-hant.promo: 在 Mac 上雙擊任何 .msg 或 .eml，立刻讀到完整郵件——寄件人、內文、附件，HTML 完整呈現。在 Finder 按空白鍵就能快速預覽，還能一鍵匯出 PDF，支援深色模式。免裝 Outlook，免登入。
zh-hant.cta: 在 Mac App Store 查看
features: 拖放，或在 Finder 直接雙擊開啟
HTML 完整呈現、內嵌圖片，也可切換純文字
Finder 快速預覽 — 按空白鍵不用開 App 就讀完整封信
一鍵將郵件匯出成 PDF
附件：開啟、預覽或存到磁碟
在 Mac 本機解析 — 郵件不離開你的裝置

qa.q: 這個 App 需要網路連線嗎？
qa.a: 不需要——開啟與閱讀 .msg／.eml 完全離線運作。只有當你從 App 選單使用「傳送意見回饋」時才會用到網路。

qa.q: 我的郵件資料會被上傳嗎？
qa.a: 不會。你的 .msg／.eml 檔案完全在你的 Mac 上解析。唯一例外：若你使用 TinyMSGViewer → 傳送意見回饋，你輸入的訊息（以及選擇附加的截圖）會傳送到我們的支援頻道。
不是。Tiny MSG Viewer 是 Mac App Store 單次付費購買，沒有訂閱也沒有內購。

qa.q: 需要安裝 Microsoft Outlook 嗎？
qa.a: 不需要，Tiny MSG Viewer 自己就能讀取 .msg 與 .eml 檔案，不需要 Outlook。

en.name: Web to PPT (Editable)
en.tagline: Turn AI-generated HTML slides into a truly editable PowerPoint — 100% on-device.
en.promo: Made slides with an AI chatbot? Turn AI-generated HTML into truly editable PowerPoint — real text & shapes, not screenshots. 100% on-device.
en.cta: View on the Mac App Store
features: Paste or import AI-generated HTML slides
Real editable text, shapes and tables — not flattened images
Exports to native PowerPoint (.pptx)
Also exports a high-quality 16:9 slide PDF
100% on-device processing — nothing uploaded
One-time purchase, no subscription

qa.q: Does this app need an internet connection?
qa.a: No — conversion, rendering, and export all happen on your Mac. An internet connection is only used if your own HTML content references external resources like images or fonts.
No. Your HTML/React input and the PDF/PPTX files you export stay on your device; nothing is sent to a server.
No. Web to PPT (Editable) is a one-time purchase on the Mac App Store — no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

qa.q: Does it use analytics or ads?
qa.a: No. There are no third-party analytics or advertising SDKs in the app.

en.name: TinyWalk
en.tagline: Generate step count & health test data on iPhone, for developers testing HealthKit apps.
en.promo: Generate realistic HealthKit step and workout samples on-device, in seconds. No ads, no account.
features: Generate realistic step count & workout samples
Writes directly into HealthKit on your device
No ads, no account — data generation is fully on-device
Built for developers & QA testing HealthKit apps

qa.q: What does this app actually do?
qa.a: TinyWalk is a tool for developers and QA testers: it generates structurally correct step and health test data on your own iPhone, so you can verify apps that read this kind of data.

qa.q: Where does the generated data show up?
qa.a: It's written directly into the Health app, tagged as coming from TinyWalk, and can be deleted anytime from the Health app.
No — it's synthetic test data for your development workflow, not a record of real activity.
The 100-step and 1,000-step datasets are free forever. Unlocking 2,000+ step datasets is a one-time purchase, no subscription.
